    OptionalfixGeometry

    fixGeometry?: boolean

    Run a post-snap intersection-cut pass to repair geometry artefacts introduced by rounding / snapping (mapshaper's fix-geometry flag). Recommended when precision or interval aggressively collapse vertices.

    • Defined in src/map/types.ts:433

    Optionalinterval

    interval?: number

    Snap distance in source-CRS units. When omitted, mapshaper picks a small default based on the dataset.
